literal_meaning: পদ্মপাতায় জল (water on a lotus leaf)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সুখ ছিল পদ্মপাতার জল, কিছুক্ষণেই মিলিয়ে গেল।
যৌবনের আনন্দ পদ্মপাতার জলের মতো ক্ষণিক।
example_sentences_in_english: His happiness was like water on a lotus leaf, vanishing in moments.
The joys of youth are as transient as water on a lotus leaf.
history: Often referenced in Bengali poetry and songs, such as in lines describing the fleeting nature of youth or love, drawing from natural imagery of lotus ponds.
note: The idiom evokes the image of water that beads up and rolls off a lotus leaf without soaking in, symbolizing detachment and brevity.
